title: My Khe Beach
text: My Khe Beach is a popular sandy beach in Da Nang, near the Son Tra Peninsula. Visitors go there to swim, walk along the coast, and enjoy seafood restaurants in the surrounding area.

title: Son Tra Peninsula
text: Son Tra Peninsula is a nature area northeast of central Da Nang. It is known for coastal scenery, forested hills, and the red-shanked douc langur. Visitors can see Linh Ung Pagoda there.

title: Linh Ung Pagoda on Son Tra
text: Linh Ung Pagoda on Son Tra Peninsula is associated with the large white Lady Buddha statue overlooking the coast of Da Nang. The statue is approximately 67 metres tall.

title: Marble Mountains attractions
text: Marble Mountains, also called Ngu Hanh Son, is a limestone mountain complex in Da Nang. Visitors can explore Huyen Khong Cave, Am Phu Cave, pagodas, and viewpoints such as Vong Giang Dai.

title: Marble Mountains tickets in 2026
text: According to Da Nang's published 2026 reference admission list, Thuy Son Peak at Marble Mountains opens from 07:00 to 17:00. Adult admission is 40,000 VND and student admission is 10,000 VND. Children under six enter free of charge. These are reference prices and may change.

title: Am Phu Cave tickets in 2026
text: According to Da Nang's published 2026 reference admission list, Am Phu Cave at Marble Mountains opens from 07:00 to 17:00. Adult admission is 20,000 VND and student admission is 7,000 VND. Children under six enter free. These are reference prices and may change.

title: Museum of Cham Sculpture
text: The Da Nang Museum of Cham Sculpture presents artworks and artifacts associated with Cham culture. Da Nang's published 2026 reference list gives opening hours of 07:30 to 17:00, with a general ticket at 60,000 VND and a resident or student ticket at 20,000 VND. Reference fees may change.

title: Da Nang Museum in 2026
text: Da Nang's published 2026 reference list says the Da Nang Museum at Bach Dang and Tran Phu opens 08:00 to 17:00. The general ticket is 50,000 VND, and the resident or student ticket is 20,000 VND. These are reference prices that may change.

title: Da Nang Fine Arts Museum in 2026
text: The 2026 official reference list gives Da Nang Fine Arts Museum hours of 08:00 to 17:00. General entry is 20,000 VND and the student ticket is 10,000 VND; the list says seniors and pupils enter free. Reference prices may change.

title: Han Market
text: Han Market is a traditional shopping market in central Da Nang. Shoppers can find clothing, fabrics, souvenirs, fruits, fish sauce, seafood products, and local dried foods. It is near Tran Phu, Bach Dang, Hung Vuong, and Nguyen Thai Hoc streets.

title: Con Market
text: Con Market in Da Nang is known for local food and shopping. It has food stalls and separate areas for dry goods and other products. Visitors looking for local dishes often include Con Market in their plans.

title: Dragon Bridge weekend show
text: Da Nang's tourism portal says the Dragon Bridge fire-and-water show is scheduled for about 21:00 on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday evenings. Special dates may have additional performances; schedules should be rechecked before visiting.

title: Han River Bridge rotation
text: The Han River Bridge in Da Nang can rotate to allow water traffic to pass. According to the city's visitor schedule, tourists can watch the bridge rotate on Saturday and Sunday nights from around 23:00 to midnight. Verify the schedule before making travel plans.

title: Ba Na Hills in 2026
text: The 2026 Da Nang tourism reference list shows Sun World Ba Na Hills opening hours of 08:00 to 22:00. The listed adult ticket for non-residents is 1,000,000 VND; prices and packages may change. Ba Na Hills is associated with the Golden Bridge attraction.

title: Da Nang airport and transport
text: Da Nang International Airport serves air travel to the city. Visitors can get around using taxis, buses, and ride-hailing services. This guide does not include route-by-route transport fares.

title: Da Nang climate and travel season
text: Da Nang has a tropical climate. The Vietnam Tourism guide describes March to May and September to October as periods with pleasant sunny conditions for exploring the coast and Hai Van Pass, while November to February often brings more rain. Actual daily weather must be checked separately.
